cover.prompt: On the colonnaded terrace of the scholars' coast library, scholar in grey chiton stands at an angled stone reading desk with arms spread wide, comparing two separate papyrus compendiums that merge without conflict; librarian in cream chiton stands beside him in a graceful 3/4 stance, pointing with outstretched arm toward the stone scroll niches in the wall, elbow clear of her torso; a fluted Ionic column and its carved base anchor the left margin of the frame; the marble facade of the library is staged diagonally at a 35 degree angle, while the sunny limestone terrace overlooks the glittering azure bay of Paxos beneath an unobstructed sky.
cover.others: a student copying decrees at a neighbouring desk.
